reason: Thirty-five dollars a month is nothing next to what can quietly go missing on a build I can't see from abroad. If it turns the Telegram pile into a sheet and a Monday report without me chasing anyone, I'll pay. But only after the free 30 show it can read my guys' handwritten nota.
objection: It only copies whatever is written on the nota. If my site guy and the toko are padding prices together, I just get a tidy spreadsheet of padded prices. And I doubt it reads a scribbled Indonesian nota correctly.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 come back with wrong amounts or suppliers from the handwritten nota, I'm out and I'll go back to Excel.
